OCR request returning multiple pages of document content

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.ocrRequestFromJson("{\"document\":{\"type\":\"document_url\",\"url\":\"https://example.com/multipage.pdf\"},\"model\":\"mistral/mistral-ocr-latest\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.ocr(request: _request)
debugPrint(result.pages)
debugPrint(result.pages[0].index)
debugPrint(result.pages[1].index)
```
